title: PredictionOutput
description: SAIA-Class S predictive governance output representing stability forecasts, harm-prevention indicators, and recommended preventive actions.

outputId.description: Unique identifier for this prediction output (UUID recommended).

inputId.description: ID of the prediction input that produced this output.

caseId.description: ID of the case being evaluated.

riskLevel.description: Predicted risk classification based on signals and trends.

trend.description: Predicted direction of wellbeing or stability.

forecast.description: Detailed forecast object containing model-specific projections.

recommendedActions.description: List of recommended non-punitive, trauma-preventive actions.

actionId.description: Unique identifier for the recommended action.
